name: StarMade
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The voxel space sandbox: build ships and stations block by block and fight over a shared universe. Installs any StarMade build from Schine's update server, every file checked against Schine's checksums.

config.startup: {"done": "Server initialization OK... now waiting for connections"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# StarMade. Installs the chosen StarMade build from Schine's own update
# server, the way its launcher does, checking every file against Schine's
# checksums. Only files that changed are downloaded, and they replace the
# old ones only once all of them have arrived and checked out. Your
# universe (server-database), server.cfg and blueprints are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
site=http://files.star-made.org
ua="raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

index=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$site/releasebuildindex") || fail "StarMade's update server can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    line=$(grep '#' <<<"$index" | tail -n 1)
else
    line=$(grep -F "$want#" <<<"$index" | grep "^$want#" | tail -n 1) ||
        fail "StarMade has no build $want. Set Version to latest, or to a build such as $(grep '#' <<<"$index" | tail -n 1 | cut -d'#' -f1)."
fi
version=${line%%#*}
dir=${line##* }; dir=${dir#./}
[ -n "$version" ] && [ -n "$dir" ] || fail "StarMade's update server sent a build list this script can't read. Reinstall to try again later."

if [ -f StarMade.jar ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "StarMade $version is already installed."
    exit 0
fi

rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build/new"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$build/sums" "$site/$dir/checksums" || fail "StarMade's file list can't be downloaded right now. Reinstall to try again."
# Each line is "<path> <size> <sha1>"; paths can have spaces.
awk 'NF >= 3 { sha = $NF; n = length($0) - length($NF) - length($(NF-1)) - 2; p = substr($0, 1, n); sub(/^\.\//, "", p); print sha "\t" p }' "$build/sums" > "$build/files"
[ -s "$build/files" ] || fail "StarMade's file list was empty. Reinstall to try again later."

# The files that are missing or differ from this build.
: > "$build/todo"
while IFS=$'\t' read -r sha path; do
    case "$path" in /* | *..*) fail "StarMade's file list has an unsafe path ($path)." ;; esac
    if [ ! -f "$path" ] || [ "$(sha1sum "$path" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$sha" ]; then
        printf '%s\t%s\n' "$sha" "$path" >> "$build/todo"
    fi
done < "$build/files"
total=$(wc -l < "$build/todo")
echo "Downloading StarMade $version ($total of $(wc -l < "$build/files") files changed)"

export site dir ua build
fetch() {
    local sha=${1%%$'\t'*} path=${1#*$'\t'} url
    url=$(jq -Rr 'split("/") | map(@uri) | join("/")' <<<"$path")
    mkdir -p "$build/new/$(dirname "$path")"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$build/new/$path" "$site/$dir/$url" &&
        [ "$(sha1sum "$build/new/$path" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sha" ] ||
        { echo "$path didn't download or didn't match its checksum."; return 1; }
}
export -f fetch
if [ "$total" -gt 0 ]; then
    tr '\n' '\0' < "$build/todo" | xargs -0 -P 8 -I{} bash -c 'fetch "$1"' _ {} ||
        fail "Some of StarMade's files didn't download. Reinstall to try again."
    cp -a "$build/new/." .
fi
echo "$version" > .raptor-version
echo "Installed StarMade $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The StarMade build, such as 0.305.16, or latest for the newest: the same one your players have. Reinstall the server after changing it.
